result:
All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers. I checked the T12 and T13 totals by hand against `orders.csv`. For the other tasks I only looked over the results.

Notes on the results:
- **T3:** the countries come back as US 3, DE 2, FR 2 and unknown 2.
- **T10:** the output prints the service names as keywords (`:db 3`), not as quoted strings.
- **T13:** the top two customers are Birch (109.97) and Acme (104.96).

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * /labels | flat * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: :dev /devDependencies | /dependencies | union dev | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * ([(/0 | keyword) /1] | join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(ne "") * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count
T11: lines * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * {:c /1 :q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4 | parseJson) :s (/5 | lower)} | filter ~(/s | eq "shipped") * mulOf /q /p | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * {:c /1 :t (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) :s (/5 | lower)} | filter ~(/s | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/c) * (* /t | sum | round 2) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
